schema.text: Would you like to add a few more details? (About 1 minute)
schema.help: If you choose Yes, a few short questions follow about moving around, heat, noise, air, cleanliness, people around and what to improve.

en.#Would you like to add a few more detail: Would you like to add a few more details? (About 1 minute)
en.#If you choose Yes, a few short question: If you choose Yes, a few short questions follow about moving around, heat, noise, air, cleanliness, people around and what to improve.

it.#Would you like to add a few more detail: Vuoi aggiungere qualche dettaglio in più? (Circa 1 minuto)
it.#If you choose Yes, a few short question: Se scegli Sì, seguono alcune domande brevi su facilità di movimento, caldo, rumore, aria, pulizia, persone presenti e cosa migliorare.

fr.#Would you like to add a few more detail: Souhaitez-vous ajouter quelques détails supplémentaires ? (Environ 1 minute)
fr.#If you choose Yes, a few short question: Si vous choisissez Oui, quelques questions courtes suivent sur la facilité de déplacement, la chaleur, le bruit, l’air, la propreté, les personnes présentes et ce qu’il faudrait améliorer.

de.#Would you like to add a few more detail: Möchten Sie noch ein paar Details hinzufügen? (Etwa 1 Minute)
de.#If you choose Yes, a few short question: Wenn Sie Ja wählen, folgen einige kurze Fragen dazu, wie leicht man sich hier bewegt, zu Hitze, Lärm, Luft, Sauberkeit, anwesenden Menschen und was verbessert werden sollte.

tr.#Would you like to add a few more detail: Birkaç ayrıntı daha eklemek ister misiniz? (Yaklaşık 1 dakika)
tr.#If you choose Yes, a few short question: Evet’i seçerseniz hareket kolaylığı, sıcaklık, gürültü, hava, temizlik, etraftaki insanlar ve neyin iyileştirilmesi gerektiği hakkında birkaç kısa soru gelir.

fa.#Would you like to add a few more detail: آیا می‌خواهید چند جزئیات دیگر اضافه کنید؟ (حدود ۱ دقیقه)
fa.#If you choose Yes, a few short question: اگر «بله» را انتخاب کنید، چند پرسش کوتاه درباره‌ی آسانی رفت‌وآمد، گرما، سروصدا، هوا، پاکیزگی، افراد حاضر و آنچه باید بهتر شود می‌آید.

hu.#Would you like to add a few more detail: Szeretne még néhány részletet hozzáadni? (Körülbelül 1 perc)
hu.#If you choose Yes, a few short question: Ha az Igent választja, néhány rövid kérdés következik arról, mennyire könnyű itt közlekedni, valamint a hőségről, a zajról, a levegőről, a tisztaságról, a jelenlévő emberekről és arról, min kellene javítani.

ar.#Would you like to add a few more detail: هل تود إضافة بعض التفاصيل الأخرى؟ (نحو دقيقة واحدة)
ar.#If you choose Yes, a few short question: إذا اخترت «نعم»، تليها بعض الأسئلة القصيرة عن سهولة التنقل والحرارة والضجيج والهواء والنظافة والأشخاص الموجودين وما يجب تحسينه.
